This paper derives stability and $L_2$-gain certificates of length-independent size for open chains and rings of modules of two alternating types with slope-restricted activations. A local and a transmission delay act independently and are only bounded and continuous. item.title: Small Average Error, Wide Individual Error: General-Purpose LLMs Estimating Energy Intake from Meal Photos in a Feeding Trial
item.description: Photo-based estimation of food energy could ease dietary assessment, and general-purpose multimodal large language models (LLMs) make such estimates easy to obtain.
